title: Corner Case Coverage Audit for Safety Concept Vectors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: real-world attacks exploit corner cases, so knowing which corner cases concept vectors fail on directly informs where additional defenses are needed. Prevents false confidence in deployment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Constructing the corner-case test suite requires creativity and familiarity with jailbreak literature. Running the probes and measuring accuracy per category is standard. Doable with mentor guidance on dataset construction.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five corner-case categories with separate probe accuracy measurements creates a moderate experimental matrix. Scoping to 2-3 categories would be tighter. As stated, it is somewhat broad for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
